detail: 6-lens architecture panel (capture, retrieval, coordination, long-horizon, adoption, alternative) produced 40 structural issues, 17 marked fundamental. Three root themes: (1) RATIONALE LAUNDERING — buildFromStructured defaults rationale to summary (record-tools.ts:129); NL parser falls back rationale=summary when no separator matches (record-parser.ts:94-96); NL alternatives get reason_rejected "Not chosen" (record-tools.ts:96). decide()'s rationale-required validation is satisfied by WHAT-as-WHY and no field distinguishes authored from defaulted rationale. Parser actively corrupts: /\s+as\s+/i separator (record-parser.ts:31) and bare /\bnot\s+/ rejection pattern (record-parser.ts:39) mangle common phrasings silently. (2) ENFORCEMENT VERIFIES TIMESTAMPS NOT CAPTURE — pre-commit compares store-global .twining/.last-record vs HEAD time (pre-commit-hook.sh:106-132); any contentless twining_post refreshes it (blackboard-tools.ts:67); store-global means one agent's record unlocks another's commit; `git add -A && git commit` bypasses entirely since only the leading clause is inspected (pre-commit-hook.sh:38,43-46). Gate 1 is prompt-injection only and its audit signal assemblyLog is an in-memory per-process Map (context-assembler.ts:45-46,69-71) — false negatives across every stdio restart, false positives forever within a process, all sessions aliasing to agent_id "main". (3) SUBAGENT KNOWLEDGE UNCAPTURED — SubagentStop posts "Subagent completed: <label>" with empty detail at project scope (subagent-stop-hook.sh:82-85); transcript_path is available and a full transcript parser exists (test/eval/transcript-analyzer.ts) but is wired only to the eval harness. Recommended structural direction: hybrid capture (mine subagent transcripts into provisional decisions for the existing promote/override drain), push a compact assembled digest via SessionStart additionalContext so delivery does not depend on agent compliance, and add CLI subcommands so twining degrades gracefully when MCP propagation fails.
summary: Structural verdict: capture launders WHAT as WHY, gates enforce timestamps not content, subagent knowledge discarded — 3 load-bearing gaps vs the goal
